text:
jamal: proposal: move RBAC enforcement into the query planner (pushdown) instead of post-filtering. quick notes and rollout plan.
priya: why?
jamal: avoids wasted aggregation work, improves cost estimates, enables SLO short-circuits.
zoe: parity concerns (row-level, column-redaction).
jamal: keep compatibility mirror mode for % of traffic.
arun: implementation: planner annotates nodes with AuthGuard{policy_id, predicate}. executor applies pushdown when safe, else fallback.
priya: cache impact?
jamal: include auth-signature in cache key for tenants with dynamic policies only to limit cardinality.
zoe: telemetry: p50/p95 render time, CPU tokens, cache hit by key-type, sampled diff rate vs legacy, auth eval latency.
priya: alert if diff rate > 0.05% for 10m.
jamal: fallback: planner auth errors -> metric -> rerun legacy post-filter.
deploy-bot: note: feature-flag + rolling restart of console-query-workers.
arun: ops: throttle sampling to <0.5% to avoid cost spike.
priya: i'll draft security telemetry doc. zoe: i'll own eval shard. jamal: i'll open PR with annotations + flags.
jamal: timeline: alpha in 2w, canary 3-4w, ramp 6-10w if green.
